definitions.explanation: Having as much as is needed; meeting requirements satisfactorily.

{十分|じゅうぶん}⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}れなくて→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}い→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: Are the preparations adequate? Is there anything else you need?

notes:
{十分|じゅうぶん} can be a na-adjective or adverb.

GRAMMAR:
- Na-adjective: {十分|じゅうぶん}な{量|りょう} (sufficient amount)
- Adverb: {十分|じゅうぶん}{分|わ}かった (fully understood)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {十分|じゅうぶん}ある: there is enough
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な: sufficient (modifying noun)
- {十分|じゅうぶん}に: sufficiently, fully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {足|た}りる: to be enough (verb)
- たっぷり: plenty (casual)
- {十|じゅう}{分|ぷん}: 10 minutes (different word!)

Note: Don't confuse with {十|じゅう}{分|ぷん} (10 minutes). The reading {じゅうぶん} means 'enough' while {じゅっぷん/じっぷん} means '10 minutes'.
